strings.zh: 今天我也要加油哦！{NEWLINE}不要被我可爱的外表骗了啊！{SCROLL}
strings.en: I’m giving it my all today too!{NEWLINE}Don’t let my cute looks fool you!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 我才没到处闲逛呢！{NEWLINE}这是我的生活之路！{SCROLL}
strings.en: I’m not just dawdling around!{NEWLINE}This is the road of my life!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 我要和这３只精灵{NEWLINE}一起变强！一起长大！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Together with these three Pokémon I’ll{NEWLINE}get stronger! I’ll get bigger!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 能跟上这个速度吗？{NEWLINE}我的外号可是超音速哦！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Can you keep up with this speed?{NEWLINE}My nickname is Supersonic, you know!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 快如电！疾如风！{NEWLINE}总有一天我也会飞得更高！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Fast as lightning! Swift as the wind!{NEWLINE}Someday I’ll fly even higher!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 你将亲眼目睹{NEWLINE}隐藏在可爱背后的的力量！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Behind that cute face lies hidden{NEWLINE}power! You’ll see it with your own eyes!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 这就是我们的团队！{NEWLINE}这就是我们的力量！{SCROLL}
strings.en: This is our team!{NEWLINE}This is our power!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 力量就是强大,强大就是力量！{NEWLINE}我要凭此力量成为第一！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Power is strength! Strength is power!{NEWLINE}I’ll use that power to climb to the top!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 你了解我么？{NEWLINE}让你看看我真正的实力！！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Do you know who I am?{NEWLINE}Let me show you my true power!!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 让你见识见识{NEWLINE}精灵的强劲实力！{SCROLL}
strings.en: A Pokémon’s strength and power...{NEWLINE}I’ll show them to you!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 精灵的友情、爱情！{NEWLINE}若要论此,不输任何人！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Friendship and love with Pokémon!{NEWLINE}In that, I won’t lose to anyone!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 它们一直保护我！{NEWLINE}所以我们⋯⋯不会输的！{SCROLL}
strings.en: My Pokémon are always protecting me!{NEWLINE}So there’s no way that we’ll lose!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 我是了解{NEWLINE}虫系精灵一切奥秘的男人！{SCROLL}
strings.en: I’m the man who knows all{NEWLINE}the secrets of Bug-type Pokémon!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 那技巧堪称精密仪器！{NEWLINE}靠计算来防御的结果是？{SCROLL}
strings.en: That skill is a precision instrument!{NEWLINE}How will its calculated defense fare?{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0311/13 | RV079: omission: 靠计算来防御 (calculated defense) dropped (D-1779)

strings.zh: 你知道这些{NEWLINE}精灵的技巧吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Do you know the skill of{NEWLINE}these Pokémon?!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 无论发生任何事都不会瓦解的{NEWLINE}那坚固的友情终于要⋯⋯{SCROLL}
strings.en: A friendship that won’t crumble no{NEWLINE}matter what... and now, at last...{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 大家为其执着感动落泪！{NEWLINE}为其毅力和顽强！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Everyone’s moved to tears by that{NEWLINE}drive! That willpower! That grit!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 我在山里住了５年⋯⋯{NEWLINE}获得的友情是永远的！{SCROLL}
strings.en: On the mountain five years together...{NEWLINE}The friendship is everlasting!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 精进武艺,为武而生！{NEWLINE}然后,为口袋竞技而生的男人！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Master fighting! Live for fighting!{NEWLINE}And live for the Pokéathlon!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 我能看到胜利！{NEWLINE}因为,我不可能输！{SCROLL}
strings.en: I can see victory!{NEWLINE}Because there’s no way I can lose!{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0311/19 | RV079: softened: 我不可能输 is a flat assertion, not “I don’t think”

strings.zh: 这些精灵们{NEWLINE}还能飞！飞到彩虹的尽头！{SCROLL}
strings.en: These Pokémon can fly even farther!{NEWLINE}To the end of the rainbow!{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0311/20 | RV079: meaning: the Pokémon fly, to the end of the rainbow (D-1779)

strings.zh: 向着胜利飞吧！{NEWLINE}飞向胜利的那边！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Jump to victory!{NEWLINE}Jump to the other side of victory!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 为什么这么跳？{NEWLINE}因为只会跳啊。{SCROLL}
strings.en: Why can you jump that high?!{NEWLINE}Simple, it’s because it’s all you can do.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 我们才刚刚开始！{NEWLINE}就算天涯海角也会飞给你看！{SCROLL}
strings.en: We’re not done. We’re just beginning!{NEWLINE}We’ll show you just how far we can jump!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 就像呼吸一样,在天空中飞翔！{NEWLINE}这对我而言十分自然。{SCROLL}
strings.en: Flying is like breathing to me!{NEWLINE}That’s only natural, if you ask me.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 该速度无法测量！{NEWLINE}超越速度的传说中的团队！{SCROLL}
strings.en: It’s impossible to measure that speed!{NEWLINE}A legendary team known for speed!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 终于到了！那个尽全力训练的{NEWLINE}道馆馆主！不知实力如何？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Here at last! The Gym Leader who{NEWLINE}trains her hardest! How strong is she?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 可爱度、强度、速度都{NEWLINE}经过进一步磨炼的女孩子。{SCROLL}
strings.en: A girl who’s polished her cuteness,{NEWLINE}strength and speed even further!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 他速度之快{NEWLINE}连闪电都要甘拜下风！{SCROLL}
strings.en: He’s so fast that even{NEWLINE}lightning bows down to him!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 奔跑吧！前面等你的{NEWLINE}是名为友情的终点！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Run! What awaits you ahead is{NEWLINE}a finish line called friendship!{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0311/29 | RV079: grammar: unclear US-style line; zh = the finish line ahead is called friendship

strings.zh: 出现了,电视上受欢迎的大哥哥！{NEWLINE}终于参战口袋竞技了！{SCROLL}
strings.en: The famous guy on the TV all the time{NEWLINE}is now participating in the Pokéathlon!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 哎呀！从新奥来的{NEWLINE}可爱又精力充沛的道馆馆主！{SCROLL}
strings.en: All right! The cute and energetic Gym{NEWLINE}Leader from the Sinnoh region!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 力量就是可爱！{NEWLINE}你相信这种力量吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Power... That is cuteness!{NEWLINE}Could you possibly believe that power?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 舍弃常识吧！{NEWLINE}这才是现实！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Abandon common sense!{NEWLINE}This is reality!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 力量就是一切,力量就是正义！{NEWLINE}力量才是友情的证明！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Power is everything! Power is right!{NEWLINE}Power is proof of friendship!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 天生的技巧才能！{NEWLINE}天才才能抓住胜利！{SCROLL}
strings.en: I’ve got innate talent! This genius is{NEWLINE}going to seize victory!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 友情？我已经对它无所谓了。{NEWLINE}因为我们已经成为一体了。{SCROLL}
strings.en: Friendship? I’m past caring about that.{NEWLINE}That’s because we are already one.{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0311/36 | RV079: meaning: 已经对它无所谓了 = no longer care, not “don’t need” (D-1779)

strings.zh: 它们一直都在保护我。{NEWLINE}所以我们不会输的！{SCROLL}
strings.en: My Pokémon are always protecting me,{NEWLINE}so there’s no way we can lose!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 华丽的跳舞,华丽的胜利！{NEWLINE}来自缘朱市！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Such splendid dancing and splendid{NEWLINE}winning! I’ve come from Ecruteak City!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 难道我们看到的是幻境？{NEWLINE}口袋竞技第一的技巧！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Are we looking at an illusion? The most{NEWLINE}skilled Pokéathlete!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 钢铁道馆馆主参战！{NEWLINE}让你见识一下坚定的决心！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Gym Leader of steel is participating!{NEWLINE}I’ll show you steely determination!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 整天精神！不知疲劳为何物！{NEWLINE}那个体力是从哪来的？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Full of energy all day! Tired? Never!{NEWLINE}Where does that stamina come from?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 胜利百分百！{NEWLINE}这个方程式现在就要被解开了！{SCROLL}
strings.en: A 100% chance of victory!{NEWLINE}This equation is about to be solved!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 早上训练,中午练习,{NEWLINE}然后⋯⋯晚上锻炼！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Morning is practice, noon is practice,{NEWLINE}and evening...is training!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 他曾说过⋯⋯{NEWLINE}不知何为疲惫！！{SCROLL}
strings.en: He once said...{NEWLINE}he doesn’t know what fatigue is!!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 我们的目标是,{NEWLINE}称霸宇宙！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Our goal is{NEWLINE}to rule the universe!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 她整个人都是轻飘飘的！{NEWLINE}重力阻挡不了她！{SCROLL}
strings.en: She’s as light as a feather!{NEWLINE}Gravity can’t hold her down!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 翱翔空中的道馆馆主登场。{NEWLINE}爸爸的精灵能在空中飞翔！{SCROLL}
strings.en: The Gym Leader of flight appears!{NEWLINE}My dad’s Pokémon really soar!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 天涯海角我们都能去。{NEWLINE}走吧,一起去,直到天涯海角！！{SCROLL}
strings.en: We can go to the ends of the earth.{NEWLINE}Come on, together, to the very end!!{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0311/48 | RV079: omission: 天涯海角 repeated promise dropped (D-1779)

strings.zh: 他头顶宇宙！{NEWLINE}脚踏天空！{SCROLL}
strings.en: The cosmos above his head!{NEWLINE}The sky beneath his feet!{SCROLL}
